nodes.description: Privileged owner address of the Owned/TravelDoge contract, initialized from msg.sender in the constructor and enforced by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (two-step ownership handover).
ERC20 token symbol, hard-coded to 'TRDOGE' in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, hard-coded to 'TravelDoge' in the constructor.
ERC20 decimals value, fixed at 18.
Total token supply, minted once in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowance table; written by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Overflow-checked addition helper (require(c >= a)) reused by transfer and transferFrom.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper (require(b <= a)) reused by transfer and transferFrom for balance and allowance debits.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper; declared in the inherited SafeMath contract, unused by TravelDoge.
Division helper with a non-zero denominator guard; unused by TravelDoge.
Owned constructor that grants ownership to the deploying account (msg.sender).
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address into newOwner.
Second half of the ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then sets owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor: sets metadata and mints 1e31 tokens to a fixed address, emitting Transfer from address(0).
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using a plain unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; debits balances[msg.sender] with safeSub and credits balances[to] with safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without a zero-address or double-spend guard.
Spends an allowance: debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction (unchecked external call after state write).
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing all plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract, sending tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, authorization checks, balance debits and allowance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) on an attacker-controlled spender address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) against an arbitrary, unvetted token contract.
Unchecked arithmetic: _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() is performed without SafeMath guards.
First addend parameter of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second addend parameter of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Named return variable holding the sum c = a + b in safeAdd.
Minuend parameter of SafeMath.safeSub.
Subtrahend parameter of SafeMath.safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Named return variable holding the difference c = a - b in safeSub.
First factor parameter of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second factor parameter of SafeMath.safeMul.
Named return variable holding the product c = a * b in safeMul.
Dividend parameter of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Divisor parameter of SafeMath.safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Named return variable holding the quotient c = a / b in safeDiv.
Caller-supplied candidate owner written into the newOwner state variable.
Address used to key the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Named return variable carrying balances[tokenOwner] out of balanceOf.
Recipient address credited by transfer.
Amount debited from the caller and credited to the recipient in transfer.
Named boolean return variable of transfer, always returned as true.
Address granted the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount stored in approve.
Named boolean return variable of approve, always returned as true.
Account whose balance is debited in transferFrom; not validated against the zero address.
Recipient address credited in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom, checked against both balance and allowance.
Named boolean return variable of transferFrom, always returned as true.
Owner address keying the allowed mapping in allowance.
Spender address keying the allowed mapping in allowance.
Named return variable carrying allowed[tokenOwner][spender] out of allowance.
Address that receives the allowance and is used as the external call target in approveAndCall.
Allowance amount set and forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded to the spender's receiveApproval callback.
Named boolean return variable of approveAndCall, always returned as true.
Caller-supplied token contract address that becomes the target of an external call.
Amount of foreign tokens forwarded to owner by transferAnyERC20Token.
Named boolean return variable of transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the calling account privileged control of the contract.
The onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorize transferOwnership.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to verify the caller is the pending owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the handover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0) after the handover.
TravelDoge constructor writes the symbol state variable.
TravelDoge constructor writes the name state variable.
TravelDoge constructor writes the decimals state variable.
TravelDoge constructor mints and assigns the entire _totalSupply.
TravelDoge constructor credits the full supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply as the left operand of a subtraction.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] as the right operand of an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter keys the balances lookup in balanceOf.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source account.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance with an underflow check.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance with an overflow check.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient entries into balances.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
approve grants an allowance over msg.sender's own tokens, so the caller controls the allowance owner key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in the allowance table.
The spender parameter is the second key of the allowance entry written by approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance debit and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
The from parameter selects the account debited by transferFrom without any zero-address or ownership validation.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the owner/spender pair.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller controls the allowance owner.
approveAndCall stores the new allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract after updating the allowance state.
The receiveApproval callback on the spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall or related allowance functions.
The spender parameter is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack, making the caller choose the external call target.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
The tokens parameter sets the allowance written by approveAndCall.
The success return variable is produced by approveAndCall.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the owner state variable both for the modifier check and as the token recipient.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call described by the unsafe operation node.
An attacker-controlled tokenAddress contract can execute arbitrary code during the external transfer call.
The tokenAddress parameter is the caller-chosen target of the external call.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
The success return variable is produced by transferAnyERC20Token.

The spender address is only an allowance lookup key in allowance.

The spender parameter is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and becomes the target of the unsafe external call.
